review_notes: Reusable means check_existing may return a reusable candidate; it does not mean equal labels may be merged globally.
ChemicalSynthesis is non-reusable in the generic entity-reuse policy; its identity is managed exclusively by the pipeline top-entity lock.

MetalOrganicPolyhedron is provisionally reusable globally only by exact CCDC number. Cross-T-Box extension execution can encounter the same canonical MOP from independently processed synthesis entities; label-only matching remains prohibited.
ChemicalInput is a contextual usage occurrence. Reuse could combine different amounts, purity, suppliers, roles, or step attachments and make their originating occurrence indistinguishable.
Vessel is reusable only within one top-entity scope; ChemicalInput remains occurrence-local and is not eligible for generic reuse.
DocumentContext and analytical or process Device classes are reusable within one document unless a stronger identity is available.
Numerical-payload veto: OM-2 quantity instances are non-reusable because they directly carry numerical values. Unit reference individuals remain reusable by ontology IRI.
Crystallize is listed as non-reusable for binary completeness but remains prohibited from materialization.
